groups.rootCause: Full baseline started before dedicated database batch3 existed; parent reran all three metrics DB scenarios green after bootstrap.
groups.suggestion: Do not generate a repair task for this already-resolved preparation race.

groups.rootCause: core.autocrlf=true checkout uses CRLF, while source/SQL assertions assume LF and bash cannot source CRLF shell functions.
groups.suggestion: Make checkout/source assertions and shell execution agree on LF; preserve actual UI/SQL/security behavior.
groups.scopeRelation: Existing full-suite harness; no reproduced defect in the four target primitives

groups.rootCause: path.join/defaultFiles/walk return Windows backslashes but test suffixes, mock recognizer, and expected lists use slash-only paths.
groups.suggestion: Normalize filesystem paths before path identity and mock classification assertions.
groups.scopeRelation: Existing lint/build-verification harness; outside target primitive code

groups.rootCause: Linux deployment path semantics are mixed with Windows path.resolve/join, Windows denies symlink creation, and Windows mode bits do not equal POSIX chmod 0600/0700.
groups.suggestion: Run Linux-specific storage/security acceptance in its supported runtime or explicitly separate platform-neutral and platform-specific checks without weakening safety assertions.
groups.scopeRelation: Existing storage/deployment baseline, no direct primitive seam defect established

groups.rootCause: tests spawn python3, which resolves to WindowsApps execution alias and exits 9009 with empty stdout/stderr; real installed Python is python.exe 3.13.7.
groups.suggestion: Select a real configured Python runtime for content-import tests; rerun guards and output equivalence rather than accepting startup failure.
groups.scopeRelation: Existing content importer validation; outside target primitive code

groups.rootCause: DB assertions expect only password_reset/pending_enroll_cleared, but CLI intentionally also emits auth.enroll_token_issued for the generated enrollment token, as documented and implemented in auditEntries.
groups.suggestion: Update exact audit expectations to include mandatory token issuance, continue asserting row order/count, redaction, transaction behavior, and account race outcomes. Do not remove security audit output to satisfy old tests.
groups.scopeRelation: Existing reset CLI tests; no connection to HTTP counter or JobState table mutation

groups.rootCause: Final all-tests job suite first parallel-claim test could not connect to the isolated PostgreSQL server (P1001). Remaining 13 job subtests passed in the same suite. No data assertion or schema error.
groups.suggestion: Rerun only the first job test or focused job suite after checking the dedicated server. If green, record the transient environment failure as resolved and do not manufacture a repair task.
groups.scopeRelation: M5-T1 test execution environment; no proven product invariant failure
groups.resolutionEvidence: db-connection-recheck.log: original concurrent-claim case independently passed 1/1, zero skip; full jobs suite also passed 15/15
